nodes.name: Postgres - Read CocoIndex Topics + Recent Episodes

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [("Validate CocoIndex Ranking Request" && $("Validate CocoIndex Ranking Request").first().json.date)] }}

parameters.pythonCode:
import cocoindex
import os
import re
from importlib.metadata import version

context = _items[0]['json']
trending = context.get('trending_topics') or []
if not trending: raise Exception('CocoIndex topic table returned no topics; fallback is forbidden')
topic_scores = {str(row.get('topic') or '').lower(): float(row.get('score') or 0) for row in trending if row.get('topic')}
ranked = []
for original in context.get('stories') or []:
    story = dict(original); title = str(story.get('title') or '').lower(); matched = []; relevance = 0.0
    for topic, score in topic_scores.items():
        if re.search(r'(?<![a-z0-9])' + re.escape(topic) + r'(?![a-z0-9])', title): matched.append(topic); relevance += score
    story['matchedTopics'] = matched; story['topicScore'] = relevance; story['combinedScore'] = float(story.get('score') or 0) + relevance * 10; ranked.append(story)
context['stories'] = ranked
context['cocoindexRuntime'] = {'version': version('cocoindex'), 'machine': os.uname().machine, 'topicCount': len(trending)}
return [{'json': context}]

parameters.jsCode: const c=$input.first().json;const keys=new Set(c.recentStoryKeys||[]);const normUrl=v=>{try{const u=new URL(v);u.hash='';if(u.hostname==='news.ycombinator.com'&&u.pathname==='/item'){const id=u.searchParams.get('id');u.search=id?`?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`:'';}else u.search='';u.pathname=u.pathname.replace(/\/$/,'')||'/';return `url:${u.protocol}//${u.host.toLowerCase()}${u.pathname}${u.search}`;}catch{return null;}};const storyKeys=s=>[normUrl(s.url),normUrl(s.hnUrl),`title:${String(s.title||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'')}`].filter(Boolean);const stories=c.stories.map(s=>{const matches=storyKeys(s).filter(k=>keys.has(k));return {...s,isRecentDuplicate:matches.length>0,duplicateMatches:matches,combinedScore:s.combinedScore-(matches.length?100000:0)};});return [{json:{...c,stories}}];

const c=$input.first().json;const stories=[...c.stories].sort((a,b)=>b.combinedScore-a.combinedScore||b.score-a.score||String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)));const proof={algorithm:'cocoindex-topic-index-v1',rankingMode:'topic-index',usedTopicIndex:true,topTrendingTopics:(c.trending_topics||[]).slice(0,10).map(t=>t.topic),recentStoryKeysLoaded:(c.recentStoryKeys||[]).length,cocoindexRuntime:c.cocoindexRuntime,candidateCount:stories.length};if(proof.cocoindexRuntime?.version!=='0.3.9'||proof.cocoindexRuntime?.machine!=='aarch64'||proof.topTrendingTopics.length===0)throw new Error('CocoIndex runtime/index proof failed');return [{json:{runMode:c.runMode,date:c.date,runId:c.runId,attempt:c.attempt,episode:c.episode,episodeSource:c.episodeSource,stories,rankingProof:proof}}];

parameters.content:
## Dedicated CocoIndex ranking service
Native Postgres reads the persistent CocoIndex topic table and recent episode history. Small Python nodes on the ARM64 external runner build identities and score topic evidence. JavaScript applies the visible penalty/proof contract. No SSH, CT143 API, hidden file, or network call exists in Code nodes.
